text:
incident-bot: PAGER: infer-runtime alert - elevated 5xx rate for model-serving pool eu-west-1 (since 3259876500). Severity: P1. Paging oncall. URL: https://pager.redwood/infer/alerts/3259876543 :rotating_light:

marta: I'm seeing 5xx spike across gateway and model-runner. 502 + 504s starting ~10m ago. CPU okay, memory on a few nodes creeping up.

devon: stack traces from one host show repeated segfaults in quant_attention.so kernel. snippet: ```[segfault] tracer: 0x7ff.. at quant_attention.c:412```

rahul: Customer impact: approx 7% of live requests failing (reports from three mid-market tenants). Support already notified via status page.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Taking lead. @marta can you gather node list and recent deploys? I'll start rerouting traffic to fallback pool.

marta: Deploys: no new model binary in last 24h. Autoscaler kicked instances up 2x at spike start. Node list: infer-runner-12..15 show OOM+segfaults.

cory: Looking at kernel logs now. I see OOM killer invoked on infer-runner-13 for process model_runner (pid 3241). Also repeated messages: "BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer deref" from driver quant accel.

devon: This looks like a quantized attention regression on latest runtime image (rt:v3.4.1). We had a soft rollout yesterday.

sre-oncall: Plan: 1) Immediate traffic mitigation: shift 50% traffic to legacy model variant (v2) and to eu-central warm pool. 2) Drain affected nodes. 3) Pin routing to rt:v3.3.9 for new requests. 4) Open hotfix PR to disable quant kernel path.

marta: I'm enacting node drain for 12-15 now. Will attach cordon/drain command: ```kubectl cordon infer-runner-13 && kubectl drain infer-runner-13 --ignore-daemonsets --force```

cory: Networking route applied to send 50% to eu-central warm pool. Should cut immediate client errors.

tess: Customer comms: I'm drafting a short update for impacted customers. ETA 10m. Do we have confirmed root cause?

devon: Hypothesis: rt:v3.4.1 + quant kernel triggers edge-case null deref leading to segfaults under certain batch-size patterns. Repro locally with stress test: batch_size=16 + kvcache disabled -> crash.

rahul: Support note: flagging tenants A, B, C — they're likely to see errors until traffic is mitigated. I've added workaround to suggest retry/backoff client-side.

sre-oncall: Mitigation statuses: traffic shift applied (50%), cordon/drain started on 3 hosts, pin routing to rt:v3.3.9 in progress.

marta: Restarting model_runner on drained nodes to collect full logs before repro is lost. Command: ```systemctl restart model_runner && journalctl -u model_runner -n 500 > /tmp/mr-logs-13.txt```

cory: Saved kernel oops + dmesg to s3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3259876543/kernel-logs.tgz

devon: Preparing PR to toggle quant path off (quick guard) and add a safety check to avoid NULL in attention init. Will push branch and ask for hotpatch approval.

sre-oncall: If hotpatch can't ship in 20m, escalate to rollback rollout (rt:v3.4.1) to stop further host crashes. Which is faster?

marta: Rolling back traffic pin to older image is faster. Hotpatch takes testing + canary. Recommend rollback now + hotpatch in parallel.

tess: Sent initial customer advisory to affected customers pointing to status page. Included note: "We're actively mitigating; some requests may return 502/504. ETA next update 30 minutes."

rahul: Logged incident in PagerDuty with severity and customer list. Escalation set if errors don't reduce below 1% in 15m.

sre-oncall: Ok rolling routing to rt:v3.3.9 cluster-wide now. Monitoring error rate.

(2m pass) incident-bot: Metric update: 5xx rate dropped from 7% -> 1.8% after routing change. Latency unchanged.

devon: I'm running targeted stress tests against rt:v3.4.1 in staging to reproduce. Found deterministic crash with this command: ```python stress_infer.py --model quantized-ggml --batch 16 --kvcache off```

marta: Nodes drained and out of rotation. Will keep them offline pending core analysis.

cory: Collected coredumps from model_runner on host 13, uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3259876543/coredumps/

tess: Customer update sent: "We reduced impacted traffic and are investigating root cause. Minimal ongoing errors expected. Next update in 60 minutes or earlier."

sre-oncall: Next steps: - Keep routing pinned to stable image for 2h - Run full cluster health checks - Prepare rollback timeline if error >2% - Dev team to produce hotpatch PR

devon: PR ready and tests passing for guard-off quant path: https://git.redwood/rt/patches/quant-guard-3259. Will request expedited review.

marta: Action items assigned in incident doc. I'm on postmortem lead.

rahul: Support will monitor tickets and escalate if customers report binary data corruption (none so far).

incident-bot: Metrics snapshot at 3259876688: 5xx rate 0.9% (5m avg), impacted customers 3 (degraded). Incident status: mitigation in place, assigned to eng-runtime for RCA.

sre-oncall: Closing active pager loop for now — shift to incident channel. If errors creep back above 2% re-pager. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
